I wrote the LRU cache in `main.wj`, and it prints the expected output for Example 1 when built and run with `wj run --compiled`. I didn't run Example 2 or any other inputs.

The cache is two parallel lists, keys and values, kept in most-recently-used-first order. Lookups scan linearly, which is fine for a capacity of at most 50.
